name: id
description: Move identifier: one row per customer per pair of consecutive month-end snapshots (the wide twin of plan_history)

name: customer_id
description: Customer the move belongs to, the same ids plan_history carries

name: moved_at
description: Month-end date of the later snapshot of the pair: 2025-02-28 or 2025-03-31

name: plan_before
description: Subscription plan at the earlier snapshot of the pair: basic, plus or pro

name: plan_after
description: Subscription plan at the later snapshot of the pair, on the same three plans as plan_before
